title: Monsters that chase
description:
Move monsters one step towards the player on a grid each turn.

```
turn 1: goblin (5, 3) -> (4, 3)
turn 2: goblin -> (4, 2) (around the wall)
goblin next to the player -> attacks instead of moving
```
hints: Try the four neighbours and keep the one with the smallest `abs(dx) + abs(dy)` to the target (lesson 11.04).
This simple chase can get stuck behind walls; the BFS from milestone 3 fixes that.
requirements: Each turn, a monster picks the neighbouring floor tile that is closest to the player (by Manhattan distance).
Two monsters never stand on the same tile.
A monster next to the player attacks.
stretch: Make monsters only chase when they can see the player (a line of sight check).
